title: pert.li project exchange
description: Portable, layout-free JSON format for sharing PERT projects between instances of pert.li. Tasks carry their predecessors inline via `dependsOn` and reference their group via `groupId`; groups are listed separately. Layout state, derived analytics (ES/EF, Monte Carlo), the auto WBS numbers, and per-user view state are intentionally not exchanged. Keep this file in sync with src/lib/pert/exchange.ts.

format.description: Discriminator — distinguishes a pert.li exchange file from other JSON documents.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped when a backwards-incompatible change is made to this schema.

exportedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the file was produced.

groups.description: First-class organising groups. Tasks reference these by `groupId`; groups nest via `parentGroupId`.

DependencyType.description: PERT-style edge relationship between predecessor and successor. Defaults to finish_to_start when omitted.

Estimate.description: Three-point PERT estimate. By convention: optimistic <= mostLikely <= pessimistic.

DependsOnEntry.description: A single predecessor relationship. The owning task is the successor. Storage-internal dependency ids and lag/lead days are not part of the exchange contract — importers synthesize fresh ids, and lag (which has no GUI control) does not round-trip.

parentGroupId.description: Parent group's id, or null when the group is top-level.

order.description: Sibling ordering; drives the WBS number index.

Group.description: A first-class organising group. Names a collapsible box on the canvas and seeds the WBS number of its member tasks.

groupId.description: The group this task belongs to (references groups[].id), or null/omitted when ungrouped.

numberOverride.description: Manual WBS-number override. The auto number is re-derived on import.

order.description: Sibling ordering within the task's group; drives the WBS member index.

actualStart.description: ISO yyyy-mm-dd date the task actually started.

actualFinish.description: ISO yyyy-mm-dd date the task actually finished.

dependsOn.description: Predecessors of this task. Empty / omitted means the task starts at project day 0.

startDate.description: ISO yyyy-mm-dd. Day 0 of the project schedule.

workingDays.description: ISO weekdays counted as working days. 1=Mon … 7=Sun.

holidays.description: ISO yyyy-mm-dd dates treated as non-working regardless of weekday.
